She tucked it beside the logbook, and that night she polished the lens a little longer than usual.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没醒来。路灯在空荡的街口投下昏黄的光，洒水车缓缓驶过，留下一道湿润的水痕。高楼的窗大多是暗的，只有几扇亮着，像有人在熬夜。早点铺的老板点燃炉火，蒸笼冒出白气，面香飘进小巷。远处传来扫帚划过地面的沙沙声。天边仍是深蓝，却隐约透出一线微光，新的一天就要开始了。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of nesting dolls: you open one doll, find a smaller one inside, and keep going until you reach the tiniest doll that doesn't open.\n- That tiniest doll is the stopping point, and without it you would keep opening dolls forever."}
